parameters.query:
SELECT
  MAX(CASE WHEN key = 'email_test_recipient' THEN value END) AS email_test_recipient,
  MAX(CASE WHEN key = 'email_sender_name' THEN value END) AS email_sender_name,
  MAX(CASE WHEN key = 'email_reply_to' THEN value END) AS email_reply_to
FROM public.global_settings
WHERE key IN ('email_test_recipient', 'email_sender_name', 'email_reply_to');

parameters.jsCode:
const input = $input.first().json ?? {};
const sqlLiteral = (value) => {
  if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') return 'NULL';
  return "'" + String(value).replace(/'/g, "''") + "'";
};
const sql = `WITH season_context AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN season ~ '^[0-9]{4}$' THEN season::int END), EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)::int) AS current_season,
    (COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN season ~ '^[0-9]{4}$' THEN season::int END), EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)::int) - 1) AS previous_season
  FROM public.membership_packages
),
selected_list AS (
  SELECT
    {{LIST_KEY}} AS list_key,
    {{LIST_LABEL}} AS list_label,
    {{LIST_DESCRIPTION}} AS list_description
),
current_members AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (person_key)
    person_key,
    trim(concat_ws(' ', src."First name", src."Last name")) AS full_name,
    src."Venue ID",
    src."British Tennis Number",
    src."First name",
    src."Last name",
    src."Membership",
    src.category,
    src."Email address",
    src."Postcode",
    src."Start Date",
    src."Expiry Date",
    src."Status",
    src."Payment",
    src."Paid",
    src."Junior",
    src."Address 1"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      COALESCE(
        NULLIF('venue:' || trim(COALESCE(m."Venue ID", '')), 'venue:'),
        NULLIF('btn:' || trim(COALESCE(m."British Tennis Number", '')), 'btn:'),
        'name:' || lower(trim(concat_ws(' ', m."First name", m."Last name")))
      ) AS person_key,
      m.*, p.category, p.display_order
    FROM public.raw_members m
    JOIN season_context sc ON TRUE
    JOIN public.membership_packages p
      ON m."Membership" = p.name
     AND p.season = sc.current_season::text
    WHERE p.category NOT IN ('Pavilion Key', 'Honorary', 'Social')
      AND m."Payment" IN ('Paid', 'Part Paid')
  ) src
  ORDER BY person_key, src.display_order, src."Membership"
),
previous_members AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (person_key)
    person_key,
    trim(concat_ws(' ', src."First name", src."Last name")) AS full_name,
    src."Venue ID",
    src."British Tennis Number",
    src."First name",
    src."Last name",
    src."Membership",
    src.category,
    src."Email address",
    src."Postcode",
    src."Start Date",
    src."Expiry Date",
    src."Status",
    src."Payment",
    src."Paid",
    src."Junior",
    src."Address 1"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      COALESCE(
        NULLIF('venue:' || trim(COALESCE(m."Venue ID", '')), 'venue:'),
        NULLIF('btn:' || trim(COALESCE(m."British Tennis Number", '')), 'btn:'),
        'name:' || lower(trim(concat_ws(' ', m."First name", m."Last name")))
      ) AS person_key,
      m.*, p.category, p.display_order
    FROM public.raw_members m
    JOIN season_context sc ON TRUE
    JOIN public.membership_packages p
      ON m."Membership" = p.name
     AND p.season = sc.previous_season::text
    WHERE p.category NOT IN ('Pavilion Key', 'Honorary', 'Social')
      AND m."Payment" IN ('Paid', 'Part Paid')
  ) src
  ORDER BY person_key, src.display_order, src."Membership"
),
member_list_rows AS (
  SELECT
    sl.list_key,
    sl.list_label,
    sl.list_description,
    sc.current_season::text AS current_season,
    sc.previous_season::text AS previous_season,
    sc.previous_season::text AS member_season,
    p.person_key,
    p.full_name,
    p."First name",
    p."Last name",
    p."Membership",
    p.category,
    p."Email address",
    p."Venue ID",
    p."British Tennis Number",
    p."Postcode",
    p."Start Date",
    p."Expiry Date",
    p."Status",
    p."Payment",
    p."Paid",
    p."Junior",
    p."Address 1"
  FROM selected_list sl
  JOIN season_context sc ON TRUE
  JOIN previous_members p ON sl.list_key = 'non_renewed_members'
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM current_members c
    WHERE c.person_key = p.person_key
  )

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    sl.list_key,
    sl.list_label,
    sl.list_description,
    sc.current_season::text AS current_season,
    sc.previous_season::text AS previous_season,
    sc.current_season::text AS member_season,
    c.person_key,
    c.full_name,
    c."First name",
    c."Last name",
    c."Membership",
    c.category,
    c."Email address",
    c."Venue ID",
    c."British Tennis Number",
    c."Postcode",
    c."Start Date",
    c."Expiry Date",
    c."Status",
    c."Payment",
    c."Paid",
    c."Junior",
    c."Address 1"
  FROM selected_list sl
  JOIN season_context sc ON TRUE
  JOIN current_members c ON sl.list_key = 'current_members'
),
contact_list_rows AS (
  SELECT
    sl.list_key,
    sl.list_label,
    sl.list_description,
    sc.current_season::text AS current_season,
    sc.previous_season::text AS previous_season,
    sc.current_season::text AS member_season,
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF('venue:' || trim(COALESCE(c.venue_id, '')), 'venue:'),
      NULLIF('email:' || public.normalize_match_email(c.email_address), 'email:'),
      'contact:' || public.normalize_match_text(c.payer_name) || '|' || COALESCE(public.normalize_match_text(c.postcode), '')
    ) AS person_key,
    c.payer_name AS full_name,
    c.first_name AS "First name",
    c.last_name AS "Last name",
    NULL::text AS "Membership",
    COALESCE(NULLIF(c.member_status, ''), 'Contact') AS category,
    c.email_address AS "Email address",
    c.venue_id AS "Venue ID",
    NULL::text AS "British Tennis Number",
    c.postcode AS "Postcode",
    NULL::text AS "Start Date",
    NULL::text AS "Expiry Date",
    NULL::text AS "Status",
    NULL::text AS "Payment",
    NULL::numeric AS "Paid",
    'No'::text AS "Junior",
    c.address_1 AS "Address 1",
    c.town
  FROM selected_list sl
  JOIN season_context sc ON TRUE
  JOIN public.vw_best_current_contacts c ON sl.list_key = 'contacts_without_current_membership'
  WHERE c.email_address IS NOT NULL
    AND c.email_address <> ''
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM current_members cm
      WHERE (
        NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(c.venue_id, '')), '') IS NOT NULL
        AND NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(cm."Venue ID", '')), '') = NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(c.venue_id, '')), '')
      ) OR (
        public.normalize_match_text(cm.full_name) = public.normalize_match_text(c.payer_name)
        AND COALESCE(public.normalize_match_text(cm."Postcode"), '') = COALESCE(public.normalize_match_text(c.postcode), '')
      ) OR (
        public.normalize_match_text(cm.full_name) = public.normalize_match_text(c.payer_name)
        AND public.normalize_match_email(cm."Email address") = public.normalize_match_email(c.email_address)
      )
    )
),
selected_member_rows AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM member_list_rows
),
current_junior_contact_candidates AS (
  SELECT
    sm.person_key,
    j.main_contact_name,
    j.main_contact_email,
    j.main_contact_phone,
    j.main_contact_mobile,
    j.main_contact_address_1,
    j.main_contact_town,
    j.main_contact_postcode,
    row_number() OVER (
      PARTITION BY sm.person_key
      ORDER BY CASE WHEN NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(j.main_contact_email, '')), '') IS NOT NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
               j.main_contact_name
    ) AS candidate_rank
  FROM selected_member_rows sm
  JOIN season_context sc ON sm.member_season = sc.current_season::text
  JOIN public.vw_junior_main_contacts j
    ON j.match_confidence = 'high'
   AND (
          public.normalize_match_text(j.member_name) = public.normalize_match_text(sm.full_name)
          AND COALESCE(j.membership, '') = COALESCE(sm."Membership", '')
      )
  WHERE COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(sm."Junior", '')), ''), 'No') = 'Yes'
),
current_junior_contact_choice AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM current_junior_contact_candidates
  WHERE candidate_rank = 1
),
historical_junior_contact_candidates AS (
  SELECT
    sm.person_key,
    trim(concat_ws(' ', mc."First name", mc."Last name")) AS main_contact_name,
    NULLIF(trim(mc."Email address"), '') AS main_contact_email,
    NULLIF(trim(mc."Phone number"), '') AS main_contact_phone,
    NULLIF(trim(mc."Mobile number"), '') AS main_contact_mobile,
    NULLIF(trim(mc."Address 1"), '') AS main_contact_address_1,
    NULLIF(trim(mc."Town"), '') AS main_contact_town,
    NULLIF(trim(mc."Postcode"), '') AS main_contact_postcode,
    row_number() OVER (
      PARTITION BY sm.person_key
      ORDER BY CASE WHEN NULLIF(trim(mc."Email address"), '') IS NOT NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
               CASE WHEN COALESCE(mc.is_current, true) = true THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
               mc.id DESC
    ) AS candidate_rank
  FROM selected_member_rows sm
  JOIN public.raw_members_main_contacts mc
    ON trim(concat_ws(' ', mc."First name", mc."Last name")) <> sm.full_name
   AND COALESCE(mc."Membership", '') = COALESCE(sm."Membership", '')
   AND COALESCE(mc."Status", '') = COALESCE(sm."Status", '')
   AND COALESCE(mc."Payment", '') = COALESCE(sm."Payment", '')
   AND COALESCE(mc."Start Date", '') = COALESCE(sm."Start Date", '')
   AND COALESCE(mc."Expiry Date", '') = COALESCE(sm."Expiry Date", '')
   AND COALESCE(mc."Paid", -1::numeric) = COALESCE(sm."Paid", -1::numeric)
   AND public.normalize_match_text(mc."Last name") = public.normalize_match_text(sm."Last name")
  WHERE COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(sm."Junior", '')), ''), 'No') = 'Yes'
),
historical_junior_contact_choice AS (
  SELECT
    hj.person_key,
    hj.main_contact_name,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(bc.email_address), ''), hj.main_contact_email) AS main_contact_email,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(bc.phone_number), ''), hj.main_contact_phone) AS main_contact_phone,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(bc.mobile_number), ''), hj.main_contact_mobile) AS main_contact_mobile,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(bc.address_1), ''), hj.main_contact_address_1) AS main_contact_address_1,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(bc.town), ''), hj.main_contact_town) AS main_contact_town,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(bc.postcode), ''), hj.main_contact_postcode) AS main_contact_postcode
  FROM historical_junior_contact_candidates hj
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL public.resolve_best_contact_row(
    hj.main_contact_name,
    hj.main_contact_email,
    NULLIF(regexp_replace(hj.main_contact_name, '^\\S+\\s*', ''), ''),
    false
  ) bc ON TRUE
  WHERE hj.candidate_rank = 1
),
best_contact_rows AS (
  SELECT
    sm.person_key,
    bc.contact_id,
    bc.payer_name,
    bc.email_address,
    bc.phone_number,
    bc.mobile_number,
    bc.address_1,
    bc.town,
    bc.postcode,
    bc.resolve_rule
  FROM selected_member_rows sm
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL public.resolve_best_contact_row(
    sm.full_name,
    NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(sm."Email address", '')), ''),
    NULLIF(regexp_replace(sm.full_name, '^\\S+\\s*', ''), ''),
    COALESCE(sm."Membership", '') ILIKE '%Family%'
  ) bc ON TRUE
),
resolved_member_rows AS (
  SELECT
    sm.list_key,
    sm.list_label,
    sm.list_description,
    sm.current_season,
    sm.previous_season,
    sm.member_season,
    sm.person_key,
    sm.full_name AS member_name,
    sm."First name" AS first_name,
    sm."Last name" AS last_name,
    sm."Membership" AS membership,
    sm.category,
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(cj.main_contact_email, '')), ''),
      NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(hj.main_contact_email, '')), ''),
      NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(bc.email_address, '')), ''),
      NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(sm."Email address", '')), '')
    ) AS recipient_email,
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(cj.main_contact_name, '')), ''),
      NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(hj.main_contact_name, '')), ''),
      sm.full_name
    ) AS recipient_name,
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(cj.main_contact_address_1, '')), ''),
      NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(hj.main_contact_address_1, '')), ''),
      NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(bc.address_1, '')), ''),
      NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(sm."Address 1", '')), '')
    ) AS address_1,
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(cj.main_contact_town, '')), ''),
      NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(hj.main_contact_town, '')), ''),
      NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(bc.town, '')), ''),
      ''
    ) AS town,
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(cj.main_contact_postcode, '')), ''),
      NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(hj.main_contact_postcode, '')), ''),
      NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(bc.postcode, '')), ''),
      NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(sm."Postcode", '')), ''),
      ''
    ) AS postcode,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(sm."Junior", '')), ''), 'No') = 'Yes' AND NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(cj.main_contact_email, '')), '') IS NOT NULL THEN 'vw_junior_main_contacts'
      WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(sm."Junior", '')), ''), 'No') = 'Yes' AND NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(hj.main_contact_email, '')), '') IS NOT NULL THEN 'raw_members_main_contacts'
      WHEN NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(bc.email_address, '')), '') IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(bc.resolve_rule, '')), ''), 'resolve_best_contact_row')
      WHEN NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(sm."Email address", '')), '') IS NOT NULL THEN 'raw_member_email'
      ELSE 'missing'
    END AS recipient_source
  FROM selected_member_rows sm
  LEFT JOIN best_contact_rows bc ON bc.person_key = sm.person_key
  LEFT JOIN current_junior_contact_choice cj ON cj.person_key = sm.person_key
  LEFT JOIN historical_junior_contact_choice hj ON hj.person_key = sm.person_key
),
resolved_contact_rows AS (
  SELECT
    clr.list_key,
    clr.list_label,
    clr.list_description,
    clr.current_season,
    clr.previous_season,
    clr.member_season,
    clr.person_key,
    clr.full_name AS member_name,
    clr."First name" AS first_name,
    clr."Last name" AS last_name,
    clr."Membership" AS membership,
    clr.category,
    NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(clr."Email address", '')), '') AS recipient_email,
    clr.full_name AS recipient_name,
    NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(clr."Address 1", '')), '') AS address_1,
    COALESCE(clr.town, '') AS town,
    COALESCE(clr."Postcode", '') AS postcode,
    'current_contact' AS recipient_source
  FROM contact_list_rows clr
),
resolved_rows AS (
  SELECT * FROM resolved_member_rows
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM resolved_contact_rows
),
deduped_rows AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM (
    SELECT
      rr.*,
      row_number() OVER (
        PARTITION BY public.normalize_match_email(rr.recipient_email)
        ORDER BY CASE rr.recipient_source
          WHEN 'vw_junior_main_contacts' THEN 0
          WHEN 'raw_members_main_contacts' THEN 1
          WHEN 'family_active_adult_address' THEN 2
          WHEN 'exact_name_email' THEN 3
          WHEN 'exact_name' THEN 4
          WHEN 'email' THEN 5
          WHEN 'current_contact' THEN 6
          WHEN 'raw_member_email' THEN 7
          ELSE 8
        END,
        COALESCE(rr.category, ''),
        COALESCE(rr.member_name, ''),
        COALESCE(rr.membership, '')
      ) AS email_rank
    FROM resolved_rows rr
    WHERE NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(rr.recipient_email, '')), '') IS NOT NULL
  ) ranked
  WHERE email_rank = 1
)
SELECT
  sl.list_key,
  sl.list_label,
  sl.list_description,
  sc.current_season::text AS current_season,
  sc.previous_season::text AS previous_season,
  COALESCE((SELECT count(*) FROM deduped_rows), 0) AS recipient_count,
  COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
    'recipient_email', dr.recipient_email,
    'recipient_name', dr.recipient_name,
    'member_name', dr.member_name,
    'membership', dr.membership,
    'category', dr.category,
    'source', dr.recipient_source
  ) ORDER BY dr.category, dr.member_name, dr.recipient_email) FROM deduped_rows dr), '[]'::json) AS recipients,
  COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
    'recipient_email', sample.recipient_email,
    'recipient_name', sample.recipient_name,
    'member_name', sample.member_name,
    'membership', sample.membership,
    'category', sample.category,
    'source', sample.recipient_source
  ) ORDER BY sample.category, sample.member_name, sample.recipient_email)
  FROM (
    SELECT * FROM deduped_rows ORDER BY category, member_name, recipient_email LIMIT 8
  ) sample), '[]'::json) AS recipient_sample,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(sl.list_key, '') = '' THEN 'Recipient list is required.'
    WHEN COALESCE((SELECT count(*) FROM deduped_rows), 0) = 0 THEN 'No recipients were resolved for this list.'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS error_message
FROM selected_list sl
JOIN season_context sc ON TRUE;`
  .replace(/\{\{LIST_KEY\}\}/g, sqlLiteral(input.list_key))
  .replace(/\{\{LIST_LABEL\}\}/g, sqlLiteral(input.list_label))
  .replace(/\{\{LIST_DESCRIPTION\}\}/g, sqlLiteral(input.list_description));
return [{ json: { ...input, sql } }];

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { flow_name: "send-member-list-email", to: $json.visible_to, bcc: $json.actual_bcc, sender_name: $json.sender_name, reply_to: $json.reply_to, rendered_subject: $json.rendered_subject, rendered_message: $json.rendered_message, email_type: $json.email_type } }}
